scenes.say: Ever had your build break because two libraries need different versions of the same thing? Let's fix that.

scenes.label: Conflicts
scenes.say: Dependency conflicts happen when different modules want different versions of the same library. This is super common in big projects.
Maven picks the version closest to your main project. Gradle usually goes with the highest version. But both can use a Bill of Materials, or BOM, to lock versions across all modules.
Here's how you import a BOM in Maven. This makes sure every module uses the same versions for shared libraries.

scenes.question: How do you avoid version mismatches?
scenes.right: Use a BOM to enforce consistent versions
scenes.say: In an interview, don't just say you let the build tool decide. Mention using a BOM to enforce consistent versions across your project.
